summary: Apollomics Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement of up to 700,001 Class A ordinary shares. Cash subscriptions total 533,334 shares at $15.00 per share, raising $8,000,010, plus conversion of a $2,000,000 promissory note held by CEO Howard Chen into 166,667 shares at $12.00 per share. Related parties, including officers and directors, participated; the Audit Committee and Board approved. This is a routine capital raise, not a special-situation event.
